subject: Mixed (Real Weightage)

questions.question: According to the Rancho Los Amigos scale, levels 4, 5 and 6 signify:

questions.question: In the Oxford technique (regressive resistance exercise), the first set consists of:

questions.question: Transverse friction massage is a valuable treatment technique in a variety of common musculoskeletal disorders. Which of the fllowing statements does not accurately describe the application technique of transverse friction massage?

options.B: A lubricant is used to prevent excessive skin friction
options.C: Fingers that are not involved directly in the massage are used to provide stabilization
options.D: The rate of movement is 2-3 cycles per second and rhythmical

questions.explanation: In deep transverse friction no lubricant is used so the skin moves with the fingers.

questions.question: In Maitland's grading, grade III oscillations are:

options.A: Small amplitude at the beginning of range
options.B: Large amplitude up to the end of the range

questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Wrist drop occurs in radial nerve injury of all levels except:

questions.question: Late inspiratory 'velcro' crackles are characteristic of:

questions.question: The hallmark polysomnographic finding in narcolepsy is:

options.A: Increased REM latency (REM sleep delayed beyond 100 minutes)
options.B: Decreased REM latency, with REM sleep occurring within about 10 minutes of sleep onset
options.D: No measurable difference from normal sleep architecture

questions.explanation: The hallmark of narcolepsy is decreased REM latency — normal REM latency is 90-100 minutes, but in narcolepsy REM sleep typically begins within about 10 minutes of sleep onset.
questions.sourceBook: Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry

questions.question: Fluidotherapy refers to:
questions.explanation: Fluidotherapy is a dry heat modality.

questions.question: Upper limb tension test 3 (ULTT3) preferentially tests the:
questions.explanation: ULTT3 (shoulder depression and abduction with elbow flexion, wrist extension, ulnar deviation) biases the ulnar nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The normal range of central venous pressure (CVP) is about:

questions.question: Mean arterial blood pressure is calculated as:

questions.question: A therapist identifies excessive femoral neck anteversion during an examination of a patient diagnosed with trochanteric bursitis. This structural finding commonly results in:

questions.question: Which layer of the pleura is insensitive to pain?

questions.question: On the angina scale, a +3 grade is when the pain is:

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: An anterior wall myocardial infarction indicates occlusion of the ______ artery.

questions.question: Amoebic dysentery stool shows:

questions.question: Medial meniscal tear is more common than that of lateral meniscus tear because of its decreased:

questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Therapists often elevate the foot of a treatment table to maximize the electiveness of specific postural drainage techniques. Standard postural drainage positioning of the __________ would not require elevation of the treatment table?

options.B: Lateral basal segments of the lower lobes
options.C: Posterior basal segments of the lower lobes

questions.question: According to Ohm's law:

questions.question: Sensory supply of the tip of the ring fingers:

questions.question: Which type of necrosis is most commonly caused by sudden cessation of blood flow (ischaemia), classically affecting the heart, kidney, and spleen?

options.D: Keep a pillow between your legs while sleeping

options.C: Any residue in the middle of the chain

questions.question: A therapist attempts to auscultate over the aortic valve. Which of the following areas is the most appropriate to isolate the desired valve?

options.A: Second left intercostal space at the left sternal border
options.B: Second right intercostals space at the right sternal border
options.C: Fourth left intercostals space along the lower left sternal border
options.D: Fifth left intercostals space at the midclavicular line

questions.explanation: The aortic valve is auscultated at the second right intercostal space.

questions.question: Compared to mature breast milk, colostrum has:

options.A: Lower protein but higher fat and carbohydrate content
options.B: Higher protein content but lower fat and carbohydrate content
options.C: Identical composition to mature milk in every respect

questions.explanation: Colostrum has a notably higher protein content than mature breast milk, but lower fat and carbohydrate content. It also contains locally-produced antibody (IgA), providing important early immunological protection to the newborn.
